newsitem.title: ITALY: Pirelli & C soars in Milan on rumours.
newsitem.headline: Pirelli & C soars in Milan on rumours.

text.p: Pirelli & C holding company stock firmed strongly on a weak Milan stock market on press rumours of a group streamlining despite a Pirelli denial, traders said.
At 1228 GMT Pirelli & C shares were up 4.19 percent at 1,940 lire after touching a session high of 1,955 in volume of over 1.4 million shares.
But Pirelli SpA shares were off 0.67 percent at 2,835 lire. The all share Mibtel index was off 0.75 percent.

Italian newspapers played up talk of a group restructuring after a Pirelli meeting with analysts on Tuesday. "Any new arrangement of the group's holdings could only benefit the group," one operator said.

But a Pirelli spokeswoman told Reuters: "Statements to analysts yesterday contained nothing new. They were just general comments the company has already made on several occasions about our medium to long-term goals."

Carlo Buora, Pirelli SpA general manager for finance, had underlined to analysts the need for a simplified group structure, repeating comments made several times but without indicating a time scale by managing director Marco Tronchetti Provera.

Buora had not given any details on projects under study but according to one Italian daily newspaper on Wednesday he had denied the possibility of a merger between Pirelli & C and Pirelli SpA which is controlled by the Swiss Societe Internationale Pirelli SA, also denied by Pirelli.
A Milan dealer said another reason for the stock's rise were expectations of good Pirelli SpA dividends "which would pour into the holding's coffers."
Other traders noted that Pirelli & C stock had been neglected for quite a while. The share touched a year's high of 2,370 lire in February and a low of 1,556 lire on October 30.
In Zurich, Basle-based Pirelli holding SIP was unchanged at 184 Swiss francs.
